retention_note: This self-contained summary preserves reviewed results and limitations. Historical receipt identifiers and digests are provenance, not a promise that disposable raw files or remote paths remain available. No new execution is reported.
duplication_findings: StopStatus and Certificate each contain equal scope/results/evidence arrays under strict join validation
Each attempted result embeds the full prepared participant Stop plan and its stage command vector
The same canonical terminal payload is stored in sequenced journal_records and recovery stop_projections in one transaction
Recovery verifies payload/digest then reconstructs status from certificate truth
Headless history is a separately transformed asynchronous durable sink; queue admission is not durable commit

participant_size_estimates_bytes.basis: Linear estimate from one sample; not measured four-participant workload, excludes SQLite/WAL/index overhead; multiple stages may grow superlinearly.

current_history_behavior: Above192KiB current detailed Stop history projection emits count-only/details_truncated form. Future approved no-truncation marker policy is not implemented in M1.

future_direction.store_once: One verified result/evidence set and each distinct prepared plan once, with atomic reference lifetime across pruning/epochs/recovery
future_direction.history: Dense history ordinal/checkpoint and oversize identity/kind/original-byte marker with bounded diagnostic review path
future_direction.compatibility: DX941 explicit decision rejects old-format journals; NO converter approved. This supersedes DX938 migration alternatives and converter-related effort estimate.
future_direction.numeric_bounds: Existing limits above are source facts; future aggregate/shared-artifact limits still require concrete implementation review.

limits: Read-only source and saved-sample audit, no new build/test/runtime experiment
No storage normalization, migration, new schema, historian policy or Stop semantic change made by this audit
Position/motion remains Stop-owned; pneumatic non-motion results reconcile ordinarily and are not counted as Stop participants
